items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid ist innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe der Widerspruch bei der Stadt Musterfreiburg, Rathausplatz 2–4, 79098 Musterfreiburg, zulässig.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 02.12.2026, sent by ordinary post by a German authority. Under § 41 Abs. 2 LVwVfG it is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Sun 06.12.2026 (this day does not shift even though it is a Sunday). The one-month objection period starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later on Wed 06.01.2027 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). 06.01.2027 is Heilige Drei Könige, a public holiday in Baden-Württemberg, so under § 31 Abs. 3 LVwVfG the deadline shifts to the next business day, Thu 07.01.2027.

warnings: The decision is fee-free ("Dieser Bescheid ist gebührenfrei") and refuses the tree-felling exemption; no payment is requested in this letter, so any demand for money referencing this case would be suspicious.
To meet the Widerspruch deadline safely, send the objection well before 07.01.2027 (e.g. by around 30.12.2026) to allow for postal transit time.
